Several months later he was punished for having served as Kaifeng's examination patrol officer without properly scrutinizing candidates who had exchanged examination answers in private. He was demoted to supervise Jizhou taxes and later transferred as transit commissioner of Jin Prefecture.

Several months later he was punished for having served as Kaifeng's examination patrol officer without properly scrutinizing candidates who had exchanged examination answers in private. He was demoted to supervise Jizhou taxes and later transferred as controller-general of Jin Prefecture.
通判晉州 is controller-general of Jin Prefecture.

Several months later, because he had once been Kaifeng's examination patrol officer and failed to scrutinize candidates, privately exchanging examination answers, he was demoted to supervise Jizhou taxes and later transferred as transit commissioner of Jin Prefecture.

Several months later, because he had once been Kaifeng's examination patrol officer and failed to scrutinize candidates who privately exchanged examination answers, he was demoted to supervise Jizhou taxes and later transferred as controller-general of Jin Prefecture.
私以策辭相授 is the candidates' collusion that he failed to detect, and 通判 is not transit commissioner.
After Wang Qinruo's death, an edict ordered his image cast at Mount Mao and enrolled among the immortal officials.
After Wang Qinruo's death, an edict ordered his image sculpted at Mount Mao and enrolled among the immortal officials.
塑其像 is to model or sculpt an image, not to cast it in metal.
Before long he was appointed acting judge of the Bureau of Internal Appointments, where he enforced the longevity regulations so strictly that clerks could not commit fraud.
Before long he was appointed acting judge of the Bureau of Internal Appointments, where he enforced the Changding personnel regulations so strictly that clerks could not commit fraud.
長定格 is the Changding personnel-grading statute, not a longevity rule.
Before long he was acting judge of the Ministry of Personnel's Bureau of Internal Appointments; he conducted affairs by the longevity regulations, and clerks could not commit fraud.
Before long he was acting judge of the Ministry of Personnel's Bureau of Internal Appointments; he conducted affairs by the Changding regulations, and clerks could not commit fraud.
The literal line makes the same misreading of 長定格 as longevity.
In antiquity the Three Excellencies did not strike subordinates. In the previous reign, when Chen Shu posted a man's name at the Secretariat, he was dismissed at once.
In antiquity the Three Excellencies did not strike subordinates. In the previous reign, when Chen Shu had a man flogged at the Secretariat, he was dismissed at once.
中書榜人 is parallel to 三公不按吏 and means flogging a man at the Secretariat, not posting a name.

Miao Shunchen, registrar of the Directorate of Astronomy, and others reported that the Earth Lodging lingered in the Three Enclosures and that the planet Venus appeared in daylight. The throne ordered the court astronomers to investigate jointly.

Miao Shunchen, registrar of the Directorate of Astronomy, and others reported that Saturn lingered at the Shen lodge and that Venus appeared in daylight. The throne ordered the court astronomers to investigate jointly.
土宿留參 is Saturn lingering at the Shen lodge, not an Earth Lodging in the Three Enclosures.
Their report held that the Earth Lodging's lingering in the Three Enclosures was harmonious and not inauspicious;
Their report held that Saturn lingering at the Shen lodge was compliant and not mutually offensive;
The memorial repeats 土宿留參，順不相犯, which is Saturn at Shen, compliant and not in mutual offense.
He was ordered to stop it.
An order was given to stop it.
命罷之 rescinds the feather-purchase order; it does not order Xiugu himself to stop.
After some time he was sent out to administer She Prefecture, transferred to Nanjian Prefecture, and later reappointed judicial commissioner of Kaifeng.
After some time he was sent out to administer She Prefecture, transferred to Nanjian Prefecture, and later reappointed judge of Kaifeng Prefecture.
開封府判官 is a Kaifeng prefectural judgeship, not a circuit judicial commissionership.
that his brother Weiji, serving as observation commissioner and overall commander of Ding Prefecture, had requested transfer to remain in the rear;
that his brother Weiji, serving as observation commissioner and overall commander of Ding Prefecture, had requested to be moved in place to acting military governor;
自請就遷留後 requests in-place promotion to acting military governor (留後), not a posting to remain in the rear.

The Cao clan from Xiugu onward was known for straightforward integrity; its women also could avoid being burdened by profit; as for Jin, he could also die for his office; and Xiumu was content with official advancement, returning home without waiting for old age—the age therefore deemed them worthy.

The Cao clan from Xiugu onward was known for straightforward integrity; its women also could avoid being burdened by profit; as for Jin, he could also die for his office; and Xiumu was also indifferent toward official advancement, returning home without waiting for old age—the age therefore deemed them worthy.
恬於仕進 is indifference to advancement, the opposite of being content with office-seeking.
The Guo clan has no great fault and ought not be deposed.
The Guo empress has no great fault and ought not be deposed.
郭氏 continues 郭皇后廢 and means the Guo empress, not the Guo clan as a whole.

He was transferred to Attendant-in-Chief of the Palace Secretariat, declined and did not accept, but requested posthumous grant for his grandfather Ning, magistrate of Laiyang, and was therefore made Vice Director in the Ministry of Rites' Bureau of Temples.

He was transferred to Attendant-in-Chief of the Palace Secretariat, declined and did not accept, but requested a posthumous grant for his grandfather Ning, magistrate of Laiyang, who was then made Vice Director in the Ministry of Rites' Bureau of Temples.
遂以為尚書祠部員外郎 follows the requested 贈 for grandfather Ning and records that posthumous office, not Guo Quan's appointment.

When Lü Hui and other censors memorialized against the Secretariat's proposal to posthumously honor Prince Anyi of Pu, they were dismissed and Yuanming was appointed probationary Investigating Censor in their place.

When Lü Hui, Attending Censor in charge of miscellaneous affairs, and other censors memorialized against the Secretariat's proposal to posthumously honor Prince Anyi of Pu as ritually improper, they were dismissed and Yuanming was appointed probationary Investigating Censor in their place.
The original drops Lü Hui's title 御史知雜事 and the charge 典禮非是, both present in the Chinese.

When Zhang Shisun was posted to Jiangning he recruited Shaolian as transit commissioner. On returning to the capital he served as investigating officer in the Censorate and was promoted to Erudite of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

When Zhang Shisun was posted to Jiangning he recruited Shaolian as prefectural vice-administrator. On returning to the capital he served as investigating officer in the Censorate and was promoted to Erudite of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
辟通判府事 is recruitment as prefectural vice-administrator, not as transit commissioner.

When Zhang Shisun guarded Jiangning he recruited him as transit commissioner of prefectural affairs; on return he became investigating officer of the Censorate and was transferred to Erudite of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

When Zhang Shisun guarded Jiangning he recruited him as vice-administrator of prefectural affairs; on return he became investigating officer of the Censorate and was transferred to Erudite of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
Literal 通判府事 is the same vice-administratorship, not a transit post.
He was restored as erudite and transit commissioner of Tianxiong Army.
He was restored as erudite and vice-administrator of Tianxiong Army.
通判天雄軍 is vice-administrator of Tianxiong Army.
He again became erudite and transit commissioner of Tianxiong Army.
He again became erudite and vice-administrator of Tianxiong Army.
The literal line repeats the 通判/transit-commissioner error for Tianxiong Army.

I grieve that Your Majesty treads the full beauty of benevolence and sagacity yet lacks bone-in-the-throat worthy assistants, thereby forming an unenduring anger and also delaying the not-distant return.

I grieve that Your Majesty treads the full beauty of benevolence and sagacity yet lacks bone-in-the-throat worthy assistants, thereby forming anger born of forbearance and also delaying a return that is not far off.
不忍之忿 is anger born of forbearance, not unenduring anger; 不遠之復 is a return/correction not far off.

Before long he was appointed judicial commissioner of Kaifeng, promoted to Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice and academician of the Hall of Assembled Talents, made Treasury Commissioner of the Three Departments, and sent out as Vice Transport Commissioner of the Two Zhe circuits.

Before long he was appointed administrative assistant of Kaifeng Prefecture, changed to Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice and academician of the Hall of Assembled Talents, made administrative assistant for census of the Three Departments, and sent out as Vice Transport Commissioner of the Two Zhe circuits.
開封府判官 is a prefectural assistant, 改 is a change not a promotion, and 三司度支判官 is a duzhi assistant, not Treasury Commissioner.

Before long he was appointed Kaifeng judicial commissioner, changed to Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice and direct academician of the Hall of Assembled Talents, made Treasury Commissioner of the Three Departments, and sent out as Vice Transport Commissioner of the Two Zhe circuits.

Before long he was appointed Kaifeng Prefecture administrative assistant, changed to Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice and direct academician of the Hall of Assembled Talents, made administrative assistant for census of the Three Departments, and sent out as Vice Transport Commissioner of the Two Zhe circuits.
Literal 判官 titles are likewise assistants, not a judicial or treasury commissioner.

When an innocent man died in Xiuzhou prison, the clerks in fear plotted to forge a confession. Before they could finish, Shaolian arrived in Hangzhou by boat, questioned the prison staff, and received their full confession. They took him for a divine judge.

When an innocent man died in Xiuzhou prison, Shaolian was then in Hangzhou. Clerks in fear plotted to forge a confession; before they could finish, Shaolian had already entered the city by boat, questioned the prison staff, and received their full confession. They took him for a divine judge.
時少連在杭 already places him in Hangzhou; 舟入城 is his boat entry into the (Xiuzhou) city, not arrival at Hangzhou.
The commentary says: The ancients had a saying: "When a mountain has fierce beasts, the wild greens are not picked for it."
The commentary says: The ancients had a saying: "When a mountain has fierce beasts, the wild greens are on that account not picked."
藜藿為之不采 means the greens are not gathered because of the beasts, not picked for the mountain.
